description: Air Link Communication Limited is a Lahore-based technology company founded in 2010 that began as a distributor for global smartphone brands and has since expanded into local manufacturing, retail and technology solutions. Its wholly owned subsidiary Select Technologies (Pvt.) Ltd. runs its assembly facilities, and the company's Lahore plant assembles smartphones and Xiaomi smart TVs. It also distributes brands including Xiaomi, Tecno, Samsung, Hisense, Apple (as an authorised reseller), iMiki and Acer.
headOffice: 152/1 M, Quaid-e-Azam Industrial Estate, Kot Lakhpat, Lahore, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: airlinkcommunication.com — Company Profile, Manufacturing, Governance and Contact Us pages, and the company's own Air Link Communication Limited profile PDF at https://airlink.pk/data/alcprofilev1.pdf (accessed 2026-10-17)
